features.title: Add item to the index using the ContentIndexer
features.expectedBehavior: Filling the fields and clicking 'Add to index' pushes an item to the Windows Search Index via ContentIndexer.Update and reports a status message.

features.title: Update and delete indexed items using the ContentIndexer
features.expectedBehavior: Add seed items, then update the ItemNameDisplay property, delete the Keywords property, and delete single/multiple/all items, each reporting status.

features.title: Retrieve indexed items added using the ContentIndexer
features.expectedBehavior: Add items, then retrieve all items or items matching a query ('0') via ContentIndexer.CreateQuery/GetAsync; results depend on the system Search Indexer having processed the items.

features.title: Check the index revision number
features.expectedBehavior: Clicking compares the tracked revision number against the indexer's reported revision and reports the result.

features.title: Add indexed items by using appcontent-ms files
features.expectedBehavior: Copies sample appcontent-ms files into the app's Indexed folder so the platform indexes them; reports the files added.

features.title: Delete indexed appcontent-ms files
features.expectedBehavior: Add appcontent-ms files, then delete a single item or all items from the Indexed folder; reports the files removed.

features.title: Retrieve indexed properties from appcontent-ms files
features.expectedBehavior: Add appcontent-ms files, then retrieve indexed properties for all items or a matching query ('Sample 1'); results depend on the system Search Indexer.
